annotations.title: Domain Expert Authority Ranking & Primary Source Discovery

description: Identifies and ranks top domain authorities, leading researchers, and primary documentation repositories for technical topics. Use when finding primary source experts to cite or discovering foundational documentation for specialized fields; for ranking general search query snippets, use synthesize_neural_search instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'subject_area' ('authority_metric' defaults to 'pagerank_and_domain_authority'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

authority_metric.description: Reputation evaluation standard: PageRank and domain authority, citation h-index, or code repo stars.

max_experts.description: Maximum number of top domain authorities to return in the ranking.

subject_area.description: Academic field, open source framework, protocol, or technical discipline to explore.

name: rank_expert_sources

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for rank_expert_sources.

recommended_primary_sources.description: Curated list of authoritative repositories, RFCs, and documentation hubs.

top_authorities.description: List of top-ranked domain experts, core maintainers, or key institutions.
